dct_title_s: Libya Subnational Population and Housing Data Tables with Administrative Boundaries, Based on National Census and Surveys
dct_description_sm: The geodatabase contains boundaries for the national and first-order administrative divisions aligned to the Large Scale International Boundaries dataset from the U.S. Department of State, as well as points for the second- and third-order administrative divisions. The feature classes are suitable for linking to the attribute data provided. The tabular data contain total population for 2012 (estimates) and 2020 (estimates), as well as five-year age group and sex, and information relating to households, nationality, population displacement, household amenities, and internally displaced people and needs.
